name: n8n AI Inbox Triage
summary: Concept: classify incoming enquiries and prepare a response for human review.
challenge: Manual inbox sorting can delay useful enquiries and bury the context needed to reply.
approach: Proposed n8n flow: receive an enquiry through a webhook, remove unnecessary personal data, classify it with an Ollama model, validate the structured result, and queue a draft for human approval. The reference image illustrates n8n agent wiring and uses a different model provider; it is not a screenshot of this proposed project. No message is sent automatically.
features: Local-model classification with a fallback queue
description: Illustrative workflow design concept using sample data. This is not a deployed product or client case study.
technologies: Proposed: n8n, Ollama, webhooks, structured outputs, human approval
imageAlt: Reference workflow from n8n documentation showing webhook intake, an AI agent, and structured output parsing; not a screenshot of an implemented portfolio project
imageCredit: Reference image: n8n documentation. This project is a design concept.
